page.overview:
Who is Balazausa?

Balazausa was a sentient female who, was a high-level bureaucrat within the Bank of Aargau, Within the Bank's hierarchy, Balazausa held a title of Depositor Councilwoman, but was also a covert contact of the crime lord Li-Suun Niik, who ran a criminal empire.

Balazausa was mentioned in the Wizards of the Coast website article Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs, Part 3: Now 99% Crime Free for their roleplaying game, Star Wars Roleplaying Game. The article was written by Cory J. Herndon and released in 2003. The Depositor Councilwoman was only mentioned as a contact of Li-Suun Niik within his information and statistics.
